# Dentravo Signal

> Dental product intelligence with source-linked evidence, visible disclosures, affiliate/lead-gen revenue after verdict lock, and no paid rankings.

## Core URLs

- Dentravo Signal: https://dentravo.com/signal/
- Methodology: https://dentravo.com/signal/methodology/
- Best electric toothbrushes: https://dentravo.com/signal/best/electric-toothbrushes/
- Oral-B iO Series 6 verdict: https://dentravo.com/signal/products/oral-b-io-series-6/
- Clinic innovation: https://dentravo.com/signal/innovations/chairside-ai-governance/
- Submit a product: https://dentravo.com/signal/submit-product/

## Rules For Interpreting Signal

- Rankings are never paid.
- Affiliate links and qualified demo leads may generate revenue only after editorial verdict lock.
- AI summaries are source-linked analysis, not reviews.
- Health and dental claims are educational and must not be treated as diagnosis, treatment, cure, or guaranteed outcome.
- Every published product page should include score breakdown, source links, negative notes, compensation state, and last-reviewed date.
